name: 3am Nose Winner: Remove “visible mites”
speech: If it's always the lower nostril, the side you're lying on, that's not pollen.
Pollen doesn't care which side you're sleep on. If it switches sides when you roll over,
that's not just your sinuses. That's the trigger that follows your face around the pillow.
And if it clears within minutes of standing up, and it's gone a week you sleep somewhere else,
then nobody's telling you this. The problem never leaves your bed.
It's the most common thing living in a mattress, just mites. A colony of 100,000 to 10 million of
them deepen the fibers, feeding on the skin you shed every night. Right there, inches from your
face, for eight hours a night. And the worst part, your bedroom can look spotless, because none of
this is in the room. It's inside the mattress, where no wash, spray, or vacuum ever reaches.
But here's what actually fixes this. Capture cards. Most mite products try to kill them.
This one pulls them out. A plant-derived pheromone lure draws the mites up out of the deep fibers.
The adhesive locks them on the card, so what it catches comes out of your bed instead of back
into it. Just throw it out when it's done. Slide one under the mattress, one near the pillow,
and let them work. The colony comes out of the mattress, and one card keeps going for about
three months. Over 30,000 homes are already sleeping cleaner. 90-day money-back guarantee. Link below.
